name: Speed Deadlift
instructions: Load a barbell to 50-70% of your max.
Set up for a conventional deadlift and pull as explosively as possible.
Lock out fast with a strong glute squeeze.
Lower with control and reset. Trains rate of force development for powerlifters.
longevityNotes: A strong hinge is back insurance. Learn it light, groove it often, and add load slowly — the goal is a back that never complains about picking things up.
overview: Speed Deadlift is an advanced hip-hinge exercise targeting the glutes, performed with a barbell. The hinge is the foundation of safe lifting — it teaches you to load the hips, not the spine.
